text:
Anya: heads-up — I can bring my CRT and a small JAMMA cab for Friday's gaming night. it's heavy, but it's got a sweet neo-geo setup.
Devin: ooo yes please :heart_eyes: can it run cvs2? :D
Samir: big yesss. Do we have a dolly + elevator clearance? that thing's ~65lbs.
Mae: elevator is fine but we have to be out by 7pm otherwise facilities locks the mezz. also need a power strip with surge protection.
Kaito: I have a IEC C13 -> NEMA adapter and a 15A extension we can bring.
Anya: perfect — top-down measurements: 24"w x 30"h x 28"d. power: 120V ~5A (tube warmup spike). bringing a soft blanket and straps.
Devin: can someone grab a CRT-to-HDMI capture? I want to stream a bit for people who can't make it.
Samir: I can bring an Elgato and an S-video cable. works with composite too.
Mae: quick logistics poll: who can help carry/position the cab at 6:15pm Friday? reply with 1/0
Kaito: 1
Samir: 1
Devin: 0 (gotta shepherd snacks)
Anya: 1
Mae: cool — that should be enough hands. Ops, any run-of-house rules about plugging in non-office gear?
ops-bot: Reminder: All personal electronics must be approved by facilities if power draw >10A or if they remain plugged in overnight. Please file a quick approval at: https://bit.ly/redwood-fac-pow
Anya: filed the form — approval looks fine per the bot.
Mae: snack status? Devin, you mentioned chips :)
Devin: bringing chips + extra Judas cola (kidding, just cola). also a power strip.
Kaito: bringing toolkit: multimeter, zip ties, velcro straps.
Samir: note for the streamers — avoid long continuous shots of copyrighted attract mode music? just in case :grimacing: 
Anya: true. I'll mute attract mode and play a playlist instead.
Devin: soundtrack swap: anyone want to add 2 tracks to the 'Friday LAN' playlist? post links.
Mae: added a couple of lo-fi tracks.
Anya: final plan: meet at 6:15pm by the loading door, two people to hold, one to wheel/dolly, one to hook up power/capture. see you there :metal:
Kaito: :thumbsup:
Samir: stoked :game_die:
